pages.title: Signing Requests
pages._note: Decomposed to type:index (Phase 8): signingRequest is OR-registered in the `signing` register, so CnIndexPage lists the requests directly. (`register` was `filinq` from Phase 8 until 2026-08-03 — a register Filinq has never shipped; see the Templates note.) Per-request signing actions live on SigningRequestDetail. actionToggles.showAdd:false + primaryAction (openspec/changes/orphaned-surface-restoration, REQ-DDOSR-004) replace the generic bare-object Add dialog with the signer-chain SigningRequestForm page — the index's own create path was a dead end (writes a signingRequest with no signer chain, fields or provider).

pages.title: Bulk sends
pages._note: Bulk sends (bulk-signing-field-builder REQ-DDBSF-002). OpenRegister lists the batches directly; the schema grants read to nobody, so each user sees their own batches and an admin sees all. A batch is started from the signing request form (Send to many from a list), which holds the document and level every row uses, so the index adds no create dialog of its own.

pages.title: Envelopes
pages._note: Envelopes (bulk-signing-field-builder REQ-DDBSF-004/005). OpenRegister lists the envelopes directly; the schema grants read to nobody, so each user sees the envelopes they sent and an admin sees all. An envelope is started from the signing request form (Send several documents together), which holds the signers and level every document uses; a signer reaches it through the request page of any of its documents.

pages.title: Signing folder
pages._note: Everything still waiting for one signer, across every case (openspec/changes/signing-folder-across-cases, REQ-SFC-01..04). It has its own /signing-folder route, so the /signing/:id detail route cannot swallow it. The list is read from GET api/signing/folder on every visit and never cached: the folder is a query, not a stored list. NO TYPED ARCHETYPE FITS, and that is why this raises the custom-page count. type:index renders one schema through OpenRegister; this screen is a cross-case queue assembled by filinq from signing requests the signer holds a mandate for, with a multi-select and one bulk sign action that writes through api/signing/folder/sign. A typed index has neither the cross-schema fetch nor that action, so declaring one would show an empty list with no way to sign.

pages.title: New Signing Request
pages._note: Signer-chain create form (documentFileId/documentName/signatureLevel/signingMode via signingStore.createSigningRequest — POST signing#createRequest, which drafts a signingRequest record; it does not send/sign/bind a provider — those remain separate signing#sign / not-yet-built provider-binding actions). Reachable from the SigningRequests index primaryAction. Restored — openspec/changes/orphaned-surface-restoration (REQ-DDOSR-004); trust/identity-assertion controls are gated to signing-trust-rebuild / signer-identity-rails per design.md D4 — this page composes a draft only.

pages.title: Signing Request Detail
pages._note: Signing request detail view driven by signingStore. Links to SignatureVerification (restored — REQ-DDOSR-004) for the document's file id. MUST stay declared AFTER the static /signing/new route: vue-router matches in declaration order, so a leading :id route swallows /signing/new.

pages.title: Signature Verification
pages._note: Read-only verify page over signing#verify/{fileId} (SigningVerificationService); renders the backend verdict verbatim, attributed to the signing engine — it does not compute or assert its own validity. Linked from SigningRequestDetail. Restored — openspec/changes/orphaned-surface-restoration (REQ-DDOSR-004).
